description: Resume to job match score (AI) — Score how well a resume fits a job posting (0-100) with verdict STRONG_MATCH / GOOD_MATCH / PARTIAL_MATCH / WEAK_MATCH: each required and preferred skill marked met or missing, every match checked against the resume text (word-for-word evidence or the skill name must appear, so the model cannot invent qualifications), required and preferred coverage %, years required vs candidate, missing keywords for ATS, strengths, gaps and honest tailoring suggestions. Score = 70% required + 20% preferred + 10% experience. Params: resume and job (text, up to 8,000 chars each) or job_url instead of job. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).

job.description: Senior Backend Engineer. 5+ years Python, PostgreSQL, AWS required; Kubernetes and Go a plus.

resume.description: Backend engineer, 6 years. Built Python and Django services on AWS; tuned PostgreSQL queries; led a team of 3.
